inventory.item: Flier Studio mark + wordmark, home link `brand`
Flier card + "Editing flier x of y" `flier-form`
Shared text edits apply to (this / all) `pick-scope`
Remove picture background (disabled with no picture) `remove-background`

Share-link import dialog (import, dismiss, error, dropped notice) `import-dialog`

Previews stay beside the form while a lower field is edited (1280: preview-1 in view; 360: mini-preview in view)
Generate from prompt heading + on-device AI wording
